_comment: Figures on monogate.dev and the claims retired from it, checked by scripts/check_site_figures.mjs. A claim names a repo file, a regex whose FIRST capture group is the figure as written, a source, and a relation: `equal`, or `floor` for a figure written N+ (the source must be at least N). A `url` source fetches text and extracts a number; a `count` source counts regex matches in a repo file. An unevaluable source is UNAVAILABLE (exit 2), never a pass. A claim whose pattern stops matching FAILS. To put a number on a page, add its claim here in the same change.

machlib_core_theorems._note: machlib's own prose gate keeps this README row equal to `python3 tools/count_theorems.py --scope core`; 7 672 on 2026-09-12.

superbest_lib_positive_total._note: python/monogate/superbest.py is the canonical SuperBEST library; /superbest's table was reconciled to it in d9a5b6c. monogate-lean's ModelAudit.lean proves superbest_v53_positive_total, 1+1+1+1+1+2+2+2+2+1 = 14: the arithmetic of the per-op sum, not that each per-op cost is minimal.

claims._note: Written as a floor so every new machlib theorem does not fail the deploy; a correction that drops the count below it does.

app/superbest/page.tsx computes its headlines and the core savings row from these four integers, so the 80.8% and 74.2% it shows follow from checked figures. Until 2026-09-12 both headlines were hand-typed strings in this JSON that no gate read.

Retired 2026-09-12: reads as 'every proof closed'. Say 'Lean theorem' and show #print axioms, which is what tells proved from stated. A line that keeps the label must also be a registered site in scripts/lean_claims.json, whose gate re-proves it on every deploy, and get a one-line `allow` here. The last two allowed lines (T19 on the Explorer and on the unserved /theorems page) went with the 2026-09-12 product-wave archive.

Retired 2026-09-12: the invented `sorry -- TODO: prove against MachLib` output. Real Forge output ends in `| sorry -- out of reach` as the LAST tactic arm, present whether or not an earlier arm closed the goal.

Retired 2026-09-13: Level 2 Lesson 3's exercise asked for a filter 'with proven stability'. An ensures bounds one call's result; it does not state stability, and nothing on the site proves a stability property.

The exercise now asks the reader to run #print axioms and see which close.

It is ./safe_pid.lean, named after its source like every other lesson's output. The command is registered in scripts/lesson_proofs.json.

Retired 2026-09-13: /learn/eml gave every level that had a page a green 'live' pill, from a typed status field that no check read. The pill now reads published or not published, derived from PAGE_ROUTES in app/sitemap-pages.ts, which check_sitemap_pages.mjs keeps equal to the app/ tree. A status word needs a check behind it. Matched as a whole word, so 'lives' and 'live-reload' pass; any other use needs a one-line allowance saying why it claims no status.
